title: Frontend client implementation

any: frontend source or visible behavior changes
a component, route, form, or client state changes
a backend contract has an affected UI consumer

requires.when: visible flow or state behavior changes
the client consumes a changed contract

skill_calls.when: frontend changes are authorized and ready
component, route, or browser behavior must be proven
command and functional evidence are ready to aggregate

nodes.obligation: Implement the bounded client behavior and required interaction states.
Run selected component, route, and browser checks at current inputs.

tests.evidence: events, validation, state transitions, and protected behavior

tests.when: visible asynchronous or conditional behavior changes
tests.evidence: loading, empty, error, partial, disabled, and success behavior

tests.when: deterministic route behavior is the narrowest useful seam
tests.evidence: observable browser behavior with only true boundaries mocked

workline_policy: Split when frontend writes and local evidence are independently owned; keep design assurance as overlays unless separately accepted.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when no client source, visible state, route, component, or changed-contract consumer is affected.
repair: Locator or fixture drift routes to test-autorepair only after product behavior remains proven.
Contract drift reopens only affected client consumers.
